story: Altadena, California. 6:18 PM, January 7, 2025. The Eaton Fire started here.

data.buildings: proxy: developed-land cells scaled to pre-fire home count

simplifications: Homes are estimated from developed-land cells at pre-fire density, not individual footprints.
Fire spread is a calibrated graph travel-time model (Dijkstra), not fire physics - one free speed parameter fit to the historical outcome.
One uniform historical wind (45 mph from 60 degrees) for all 12 hours; no ember spotting, no weather change.
Fuel breaks slow fire 50x rather than stopping it; costs are rough mechanical-treatment magnitudes, not bids.
Fuels are LANDFIRE LF2024_FBFM40 (pre-fire vintage), terrain LANDFIRE LF2020_Elev, both resampled to a 60 m grid.
